dedupe_keys.name: hydropot integral hydropower potential and ecological value of reaches of the swiss river network version 2016

description: HYDROpot_integral is a spatial dataset and method to weigh hydropower potential against the ecological potential of the Swiss river network, version 2016. It grew out of a dissertation at the University of Bern in 2012 to give a standard basis for judging the many small hydropower applications (up to 10 MW) that followed a Swiss funding instrument introduced in 2009. The river network (GWN07) is split into reaches of about 450 m; for each reach a river space and a wider surrounding landscape are assessed against regulating, cultural and provisioning ecosystem functions using 73 geodata sets, and the theoretical hydraulic potential is computed for the whole network, so reaches can be classed as better suited to use or to protection. EnviDat published the data in 2022 as a zip archive of about 50 MB, available for free download under CC BY-SA 4.0, with indicator documentation on the WSL GitLab. Coverage is Switzerland. Caveats: the data reflect the 2016 version, the potential is theoretical, not an assessment of specific plants, and the method was tested on cantonal and national data. Simulation uses are reach-level small hydropower potential screened by ecological value for renewable capacity planning. Related records: data-swiss-domestic-biomass-energy-potentials-wsl covers another Swiss renewable potential.
